status: research estimate; conditional historical benchmark calibration
method: Historical GiveWell funding-opportunity mortality benchmark transferred to an ordinary gift, with independent analyst finite survival-to-QALY conversion
scope: Whole ordinary gift cash charged; modeled representative core only. Not a current restricted offer or GiveWell QALY estimate.

lineage.convention: Independent age-aware calibration; original v1 models retained
lineage.originalModels: Preserve original AMF and NI v1 assets and outputs unchanged as separately labeled constructed stresses; do not combine their ladders with this calibration.

costPerspective.explanation: No matched incremental companion-resource denominator. Do not carry forward old per-net or per-catchment allowances. Optional gross associated costs are a separate perspective, not a net societal ICER.

sources.supports: Rounded 2022–24 grant-weighted funding-opportunity dollars per modeled life: AMF5500, NI4500; not every unrestricted gift. Native estimates incorporate other-funder responses.
Section4.3 includes older-child/adult mortality; Uganda illustration294 early+70 older deaths. Does not establish portfolio age mix or our survival trajectory.

sources.parameterVintage: 2024-09 cost section; page includes mixed-vintage analyses
sources.supports: Childhood and later mortality pathways; enrolled and additionally vaccinated denominators differ; moral-weighted benefit shares are not death-age shares.
Existing funded support into2028; does not establish current marginal gift price or source the assumed event timing.
Observational22-year follow-up supports persistence qualitatively, not a fitted40-year lifetable or generic .8 multiplier.

assumptions.survival: All horizons, annual survival, utility and midpoint integration are analyst trajectories, not national lifetables. Finite truncation does not imply death at horizon.
assumptions.age: 80%early/20%older is an analyst prior for both. AMF Uganda example is supporting context, not a grant-weighted empirical share. NI share is not inferred from moral-weighted benefit percentages.
assumptions.yield: 1 transfers historical adjusted mortality yield to a representative ordinary gift; it is not proof of no substitution. Do not append old funding, efficacy, coverage or trial-transfer haircuts.
assumptions.persistence: No extra generic persistence penalty centrally; .8 sensitivity is distinct from the .8 age share.
assumptions.harm: Only new harms not already in the source benchmark. Harm inputs are whole-gift present-value QALYs for the specified gift, not per dollar or per death; shared harm scales with relative yield, independent harm does not. Re-specify harms if changing gift scale.
assumptions.geography: Zero direct SF/Bay modeled health. Unknown indirect health receives no credit; a global price is not a local price.
assumptions.ranges: Scenarios are possibilities, not confidence intervals; no tuning to a target.

amf.name: Against Malaria Foundation
amf.coreAllocationMeaning: Representative ordinary-gift core prior; not verified current allocation or an overhead rate.
amf.timingMeaning: Analyst mean gift-to-event delay for near-term protection of both current children and adults; not observed pipeline timing.

ni.name: New Incentives
ni.coreAllocationMeaning: Analyst representative immunization-core allocation; 10%health-unquantified, not valueless. Not an overhead discount on already costed delivery.
ni.timingMeaning: Analyst equal early-event weights after implementation delay; older mortality occurs as vaccinated cohort ages. Not measured current death-age distribution.
